source_title: One Piece Unveils The Strongest God Devil Fruit From The Void Century
source_excerpt:
One Piece's Elbaf arc is currently in its climax, awaiting the release of Chapter 1197, which is set to be published in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 49 on November 1, 2026. As the Elbaf conflict heats up, Eiichiro Oda, the creator of the series, continues to unveil powerful Devil Fruit abilities.
Given that One Piece is in the last stretch of the story, it is no surprise to know that the series is now gradually delving deeper into the Void Century. The climax of the Elbaf arc, in that regard, has officially unveiled to us the strongest God Devil Fruit from the Void Century with the official arrival of Nerona Imu in the country on April 5, 2026, in Chapter 1179.
One Piece's Akuma no Mi Is The Strongest Void Century Devil Fruit
On April 5, 2026, One Piece Chapter 1179 was officially released in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 19. This chapter was incredibly important in the grand scheme of things for the Elbaf arc, as it marked the descent of Nerona Imu, the King of the World, on Elbaf. After having been teased as the main antagonist and the ruler of the entire world back in the Reverie arc, fans were eagerly waiting to see Imu's full appearance as well as powerful abilities. However, no fan was expecting Imu to show up in Elbaf as the main antagonist. That is precisely where Eiichiro Oda shocked all of us, as Imu became the primary villain for Luffy and the Straw Hats to take down.
Creator of the World Government (One of the First 20)
Power: Akuma no Mi (The Devil's Fruit)
— Imu's introduction box, One Piece Chapter #1179
Naturally, this also gave us a look at Imu's Devil Fruit ability, which is the Akuma no Mi. One Piece Chapter 1179 confirmed Imu's Akuma no Mi to be a primordial Devil Fruit that is unlike any other that exists in the world. Imu's Devil Fruit is a God ability, but more than that, it does not carry a dual naming pattern. It is simply known as the Akuma no Mi or The Devil's Fruit, meaning that it was the first of its kind and the most special ability to exist in the entire world . Over the course of the Elbaf arc climax, Imu's Devil Fruit ability has allowed him to transform into a Demon God of the world with the unique powers of God's Domination, as confirmed in Chapter 1181 in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump 2026 Double Issue 22-23.
Loki: So your power is God's Domination? Think you mean a contract with the Devil!
Imu: God? Devil? What is the difference?
— Loki and Imu explain God's Domination, One Piece Chapter #1181
At the same time, Imu's fruit also gives him the ability to manipulate the black flames of Omen, as confirmed in the very same chapter on April 27. These abilities, put together with Imu's powerful Haki, make him a force to be reckoned with and the strongest God to stem from the Void Century. While Imu's Haki is incredibly impressive, the most powerful ability that he wields is the Akuma no Mi, which is the ultimate Devil Fruit of the One Piece world . It grants powers great enough to not only destroy the world but also to establish a new world order and completely control it.
"Omen is my military might. It's a power that dwells within all living things. People crave power. However, if the power they crave is obtained through ease, it leads to corruption." — Imu explains Maki, One Piece Chapter #1181
Why Nika Fruit Pales In Comparison To Akuma no Mi
In the world of One Piece , there are quite a few special Devil Fruits that fans consider to be the strongest. Among them is Monkey D. Luffy's Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika, which was officially unveiled to us properly in One Piece Chapter 1044 on March 28, 2022, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 17. This Devil Fruit was formerly known as Gomu Gomu no Mi, but in this chapter, its true nature was finally confirmed. Luffy's Devil Fruit allows him to transform into the Sun God Nika or the Warrior of Liberation. This Devil Fruit ability is incredibly powerful and is rightly known to be the most ridiculous of all.
"Awakening [the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika] further strengthens their rubber body and gives them even more freedom, limited only by their own imagination. It is allegedly the most ridiculous power to exist in the entire world!" — Gorosei explain Luffy's Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika Awakening, One Piece Chapter #1044
However, there is a specific distinction between the most ridiculous ability and the most dangerous ability of all time. While Luffy's Nika powers are immense, they do not hold a candle to Nerona Imu's Akuma powers. As has been clearly seen in the climax of the Elbaf arc, Imu's Akuma abilities far outclass Luffy's Nika. In One Piece Chapter 1188, which was officially released on July 13, 2026, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 33, Nerona Imu's Akuma no Mi powers clearly outclassed Luffy's Nika abilities, and the former nearly killed him .
"Of course I know that thou art not Joy Boy! Joy Boy was not this weak!!" — Imu mocks Luffy, One Piece Chapter #1188
What makes this comparison even more surprising is the fact that Nerona Imu's Akuma no Mi abilities are severely nerfed right now. This was confirmed directly in One Piece Chapter 1182 on May 10, 2026, in Shonen Jump Issue 24. Given that Imu's abilities are very limited and Luffy was at the peak of his powers, the difference in power couldn't be clearer.
Sign in to claim your place on the leaderboard!
In One Piece chapter 1197, set to be officially released on November 1, 2026, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 49, we may get yet another look at Nerona Imu's Akuma no Mi abilities. When taking into consideration the power that he has shown with this Devil Fruit so far, it is already clear that he is the strongest in the entire world. Imu, as things stand, has already defeated the likes of Luffy, Loki, Gaban, Zoro, Sanji, Hajrudin, Stansen, and Gerd in combat effortlessly, and he has done so without even taking a break. The fact that this isn't even Imu's full power, as confirmed in One Piece chapter 1182, goes to show that his true power is immeasurable.
"Great Imu's body isn't meant to sustain the outside. But even pushing past that, the strength we need and the strength we ought to destroy are both right here." — Saint Sommers confirms Imu's nerf, One Piece Chapter #1182
This resonates with what Shanks stated to Loki long ago pertaining to Imu's abilities. Shanks, as is quite clear to see in the story, is incredibly powerful and one of the strongest Haki users in the entirety of One Piece. Yet, even he labeled Imu's power as simply immeasurable. Undoubtedly, Imu is the strongest Devil Fruit user in the entire world, and the fact is that his Akuma no Mi abilities have not been fully utilized. Even though Joy Boy was a legendary Devil Fruit user from the Void Century alongside many others, Imu's Akuma no Mi prevailed and stands as the strongest Void Century Devil Fruit of all time .
